y-m-83-07.title: Warbixin sheegaysa xeerka leh suurtagalnimo ugu yar inuu ugu badbaado badan yahay
y-m-83-07.goal: Hel khaladka warbixin tirintiisu sax tahay laakiin gunaanadkeedu khaldan yahay, adigu naqshadee xeerar buuxiya shuruudaha, oo ka xukun malaynta loo baahan yahay si loo ka hadlo fursad adigoo isticmaalaya tirada suurtagalnimooyinka.
y-m-83-07.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan go'aaminno xeerka lambarka qufulka shaybarka koox. Lambarku wuxuu leeyahay 4 lambar, meel kasta-na waxay isticmaashaa mid ka mid ah lambarrada 0 ilaa 9. Xeerka R1 wuxuu oggol yahay isla lambar in dhowr jeer la isticmaalo, R2 wuxuu u baahan yahay in afarta lambar dhammaantood ay kala duwan yihiin, R3-na wuxuu oggol yahay isla lambar laakiin lambarka koowaad waa inuusan noqon 0. Arday ayaa qoray qayb ka mid ah warbixin isbarbar dhigaysa xeerarka iyadoo tiriyey lambarrada suurtagalka ah xeer kasta hoostiisa. Sida lambarka loo doorto weli lama go'aamin.
y-m-83-07.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha in gunaanadku khaldami karo xitaa haddii xisaabtu sax tahay
y-m-83-07.prereq.0: Malaynta nidaamka dugsiga: kani waxaa loo arkaa hawl baadhitaan oo lagu dabaqo kadib barashada tirinta (xeerka wax-ku-dhufashada, kala horreynta) iyo fikradaha aasaasiga ah ee fursadda. 'H3' waa calaamad keliya oo heerka adkaanta ururka soo saarka, maaha qoondayn fasal.
y-m-83-07.prereq.2: Fikradda ah marka kiisaska suurtagalka ah ay isku fursad yihiin, fursaddu waa 1/(tirada kiisaska)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.prompt: Kani waa warbixin isbarbar dhigaysa xeerarka lambarka qufulka shaybarka koox (4 lambar) iyadoo la raacayo tirada suurtagalnimooyinka. Dooro hal khad oo sababeyntiisu aanay ku habboonayn. (Lambarrada khadadka waxaa shaashadda lagu muujiyaa laga bilaabo 1.)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.0: Xeer kasta, erayo ku sheeg imisa lambar ayaa jira oo la dooran karo marka aad doorato hal lambar oo aad isku daydo inaad qiyaasto.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig sida fursadda qiyaasidda u kala duwan tahay marka aad doorato lambar kasta haddii ay jiraan 5040 suurtagalnimo iyo 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.0: Xeerka R1 (isla lambar waa la isticmaali karaa dhowr jeer): meel kasta waxay isticmaali kartaa mid kasta oo ka mid ah 0 ilaa 9, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 10×10×10×10 = 10000 suurtagalnimo.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.1: Xeerka R2 (afarta lambar dhammaantood kala duwan): 10 koowaad, 9 labaad, 8 saddexaad, 7 afraad, sidaas darteed 10×9×8×7 = 5040 suurtagalnimo.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.2: Xeerka R3 (isla lambar waa la oggol yahay laakiin meesha koowaad maaha 0): 9 koowaad iyo 10 mid kasta oo inta kale ah, sidaas darteed 9×10×10×10 = 9000 suurtagalnimo.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed tirada suurtagalnimooyinka waa R2 < R3 < R1. R2, oo leh suurtagalnimooyinka ugu yar, waa kan ugu badbaado badan.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed isticmaalka xeer aan oggolayn lambarrada soo noqnoqda wuxuu ka dhigaa lambarka mid ka badbaado badan.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.explain: Tirinta suurtagalnimooyinka khadadka 1 ilaa 3 (10000, 5040, 9000) waa sax. Laakiin khadka 4 wuxuu yidhi xeerka leh suurtagalnimooyinka ugu yar waa kan ugu badbaado badan. Marka qof kale uu isku dayo inuu qiyaaso lambarka isagoo doorsanaya, marka lambarrada suurtagalka ah ay badan yihiin, way adag tahay in la qiyaaso. Khadka 5 waa gunaanad ka timid isla khalad.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.prompt: Markan, adigu naqshadee xeerka qufulka. Tirada koodhadhka suurtagalka ah waa inay noqotaa 1,000,000 ama ka badan, oo si ay u fududaato in la xasuusto, dhererku waa 5 ama ka yar. Tirada noocyada xarfaha aad isticmaali karto, k, waa mid ka mid ah 10 (lambarro oo keliya), 26 (xarfo yaryar oo Ingiriis ah oo keliya), 36 (lambarro + xarfo yaryar oo Ingiriis ah), ama 62 (lambarro + xarfo Ingiriis ah labada nooc), isla xarafkana waa la isticmaali karaa dhowr jeer. Hel 3 (k, n) oo kala duwan oo buuxiya shuruudaha.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro k iyo n hal hal oo xisaabi imisa koodh oo suurtagal ah ayaa jira. Hubi haddii k qaar xitaa n le'eg 5 aanay ku filnayn.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.1: Dhig n 4 iyo 5 oo isbarbar dhig k intee weyn waa inay noqotaa si ay shuruudda uga gudubto.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c1: k waa qiime la oggol yahay.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c1: k waa inuu noqdaa mid ka mid ah 10, 26, 36, 62.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Dhererku waa tiro dabiici ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Dhererka n waa inuu noqdaa tiro dabiici ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Waxaa jira 1,000,000 koodh oo suurtagal ah ama ka badan.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Tirada koodhadhka suurtagalka ah (k oo lagu dhufto n jeer) waa ka yar tahay 1,000,000.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.explain: Kiisaska k^n≥1,000,000 waa (26, 5)=11,881,376, (36, 4)=1,679,616, (36, 5), (62, 4), (62, 5). Lambarro oo keliya (k=10), n=5 wuxuu bixiyaa 100,000 suurtagalnimo oo keliya, sidaas darteed dherer 6 ayaa loo baahan lahaa, 4 xarfood oo yaryar oo Ingiriis ah (26⁴=456,976) sidoo kale kuma filna.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad tidhaahdo 'xeerka R1 hoostiisa, fursadda qiyaasidda lambarka hal doorasho waa 1/10000.' Si bayaankani u run noqdo, malayn noocee ah ayaa loo baahan yahay oo soo socda?
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nolosha dhabta ah ka fikir haddii dhammaan 10000 lambar ee suurtagalka ah la isticmaali doono isla marar.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hel halka malaynta 'isku fursad' lagu isticmaalo xisaabta bixisa fursadda 1/10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.a: Lambarku waa inuu sahlan yahay in la xasuusto, sida 1234, oo waa inuusan soo noqnoqon.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.a: Lambarrada si fudud loo xasuusto waa kuwa dadku marka hore tijaabiyaan. Waxay fududayn karaan qiyaasidda.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.b: Qofka isku dayaya inuu qiyaaso waa inuu horey u tijaabiyey hal ama laba mar oo uu guuldaraystay.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.b: Haddii ay horey u tijaabiyeen maaha fursadda isku daygii koowaad. Xalli fursadda 1/10000 waa fursadda maxay.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.c: 10000-ka lambar waxaa loo doortay isku fursad, qofka qiyaasayna wuxuu yaqaan xeerka.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.c: Waad ogtahay in fursaddu noqoto 'is-rogga tirada suurtagalnimooyinka,' malayntu ay lagama maarmaan tahay in kiisaska suurtagalka ah ay isku fursad yihiin.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.d: Xeerka waa in loo beddelaa mid sida R2 oo aan oggolayn lambarrada soo noqnoqda.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.d: Shuruuddani xiriir la'aan ayay la leedahay waxa xeerka R1 yahay. Haddii aad R1 u beddesho R2, tirada suurtagalnimooyinku laftigeedu way is beddelaa.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.explain: Si is-rogga tirada suurtagalnimooyinka uu u noqdo fursadda, waxaad u baahan tahay malaynta ah in lambarrada suurtagalka ah loo doortay isku fursad. Haddii dadku inta badan doortaan maalmaha dhalashada ama 1234, fursadda dhabta ah ee qiyaasidda ayaa ka sarreyn karta tan. Tirada suurtagalnimooyinka waa hal aasaas oo keliya oo badbaado ah.

y-m-83-01.title: Ma ka sheegi karnaa toddobaadka tobnaad tibaaxda shan bar ku habboon?
y-m-83-01.topic: Moodelada hawlaha ku habboon xogta iyo sii-sheegidda kala duwanaanshaha dibaddiisa
y-m-83-01.goal: Raac habka helitaanka moodel labajibbaaran oo ku habboon xogta, dib u eeg sii-sheegidaha iyo kalsoonida marka xog cusub timaaddo, oo sheeg kala duwanaansho kee ayaa moodelka lagu kalsoonaan karaa.
y-m-83-01.material: Naadi sayniska ah ayaa ku beeraya hal dhir digir kelyo ah dheri guri gudaha ah. Isla maalinta toddobaadka isla waqtiga, waxay ku cabbiraan dhererka jilibka sharci, waxay ku qoraan cm ugu dhow, oo waxay siiyaan isla biyo iyo iftiin toddobaad kasta. Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa marxalad marxalad, marxalad kastana waxaad go'aamisaa sida loo sheego dhererka ka dib toddobaadka 5.
y-m-83-01.thinking.0: Doorashada moodel iyadoo laga eegayo sida kororku u beddelmo
y-m-83-01.thinking.1: Hagaajinta sii-sheegidaha iyo kalsoonida xog cusub
y-m-83-01.thinking.2: Kala saaridda kala duwanaanshaha moodelku ku dabaqmo xadka xaqiiqada
y-m-83-01.prereq.0: Malo-awaalka nidaamka dugsiga: tani waxaa loo arkaa hawl baaritaan ah oo la dabaqo ka dib barashada qaybta hawlaha (hawlaha toosan iyo labajibbaaran). 'H3' waa calaamad keliya oo heerka adkaanta qaybintan wax-soo-saarka mana tusayso in maado kasta ay u dhigmayso fasal kasta.
y-m-83-01.prereq.1: Helitaanka iyo isbarbar dhigga isbeddelada (kororka) qiimayaasha shaxda
y-m-83-01.prereq.2: Helitaanka qiimayaasha tibaaxaha hawsha toosan iyo labajibbaarka
y-m-83-01.s.s1.prompt: Xogta dhererka digirka kelyada ee toddobaad-toddobaad la cabbiray waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Mar kasta oo mid la muujiyo, dooro fikirkaaga ku saabsan dhererka toddobaadka 5 (kadibna toddobaadka 10), oo dib u eeg fikirkaaga marka xogtu kordho. Ilaalinta fikirkaagii koowaad sidoo kale way fiicantahay haddii aad leedahay caddayn.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.hint.0: Marka xog cusub soo baxdo, marka hore isbarbar dhig intee le'eg ayuu sii-sheegiddaadu ka duwanayd qiimahaas.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dhinac dhinac u qor kororka dhererka toddobaad kasta, oo eeg sida kororka laftiisu u beddelmo.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Naadi sayniska ah ayaa ku beeraya hal dhir digir kelyo ah dheri guri gudaha ah. Qiimayaasha la cabbiray waa 4cm toddobaadka 1, 7cm toddobaadka 2, iyo 12cm toddobaadka 3.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Waa inaad sii sheegtaa dhererka toddobaadka 5. Xogta hadda jirta oo keliya, waa kuma habka ugu macquulsan ee loo sheegi karo?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Saddex bar oo keliya, moodelo kala duwan oo dhan xogta way ku habboonaan karaan. Waxa muhiimka ah waa in kororka oo ka beddelma 3 ilaa 5 uu shaki galiyo malo-awaalka 'wuxuu u korayaa isla dherer toddobaad kasta.'

y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad u akhrisay isbeddelka kororka sida xeer oo waxaad xeerkaas u sheegtay 'malo-awaal'. Sidoo kale waxaad tiri saddex bar oo keliya way u baahan yihiin hubin.

y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Taxaddar yeelashada marka xogtu yar tahay way fiican tahay. Laakiin 'sheegidda malo-awaalka iyo bixinta kala duwanaansho' way ka duwan tahay 'inaan waxba la odhan'.

y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Celceliska kororka afarta qiime waa 5cm, sidaa darteed waxaan isticmaalayaa sida uu yahay oo waxaan sii sheegayaa 24cm toddobaadka 5.

y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad heshay xeer sii wada isbeddelka kororka oo waxaad u isticmaashay sii-sheegidda.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Xeerka kororku wuu sax u muuqdaa, laakiin waxaa jira afar bar oo keliya, sidaa darteed waxaan idhi qiyaastii 28cm oo waxaan idhi waan ku hubin doonaa cabbirka toddobaadka 5.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Intaad xeerka u isticmaalayso sii-sheegidda, waxaad ka gaar ka dhigtay qaybta aan weli la xaqiijin.

y-m-83-02.title: Ma 100 bar ay kala saari karaan 3.12 iyo 3.14?
y-m-83-02.goal: Warbixin qiyaastay π iyadoo si kadis ah loo dhigay baro, hel halka ay sheegashooyin aad u adag ka bixiso, sheeg xadka gunaanadka iyadoo la raacayo sida natiijooyinka soo noqnoqda ay u kala firidhsan yihiin, oo naftaada naqshadee tijaabo ka rumaysan.
y-m-83-02.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan qiyaasno qiimaha pi (π) jilitaan. Sagxadda isku-xidhka, kombiyuutar ayaa si siman u dhigaya baro kadis ah afar-gees dhexdiisa leh 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 iyo 0 ≤ y ≤ 1 (dhererka dhinaca 1). Haddii x² + y² < 1 (x labajibbaaran ku dar y labajibbaaran waa ka yar yahay 1), barta waxay ku jirtaa kala-wareeg leh qotoda dhexe 1. Aagga kala-wareegga waa π/4 aagga afar-gees na waa 1, sidaa darteed ixtimaalka barta ay kala-wareegga ku dhacdo waa π/4. Hal koox ayaa dhigtay 100 bar oo qortay warbixin.
y-m-83-02.thinking.1: Isbarbar dhigga sida natiijooyinka soo noqnoqda ay u kala firidhsan yihiin
y-m-83-02.prereq.0: Malo-awaalka nidaamka dugsiga: tani waxaa loo arkaa hawl baaritaan ah oo la dabaqo ka dib barashada qaybta ixtimaalka (ixtimaalka laga helo aagga, soo noqnoqoshada tijaabooyinka). 'H3' waa calaamad keliya oo heerka adkaanta qaybinta wax-soo-saarka ma aha meelayn fasal.
y-m-83-02.prereq.1: Qaacidada aagga wareegga iyo macnaha kala-wareegga
y-m-83-02.prereq.2: Fikirka ah in ixtimaal uu yahay saamiga aagagga (qaacidada leexashada caadiga ah looma baahna)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.prompt: Kani waa qayb ka mid ah warbixin koox qortay. Dooro hal sadar oo caddayntu ku filnayn habka gaarista gunaanadka. (Lambarrada sadarrada waxay ka bilaabmaan 1 shaashadda.)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta u kala saar 'waxa la arkay,' 'waxa la xisaabiyey,' ama 'waxa loo go'aamiyey gunaanad.'
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii aad isla tijaabada mar kale samayso, ka fikir haddii 78 si sax ah mar kale soo bixi doonto.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.0: 100 bar ayaa si kadis ah loogu dhigay afar-gees gudihiisa.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.1: Kuwaas dhexdooda, baraha x² + y² < 1, taasi waa, baraha kala-wareegga ku jira, waxay ahaayeen 78.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.2: Ixtimaalka barta ay kala-wareegga ku dhacdo waa saamiga aagga π/4, sidaa darteed waxaan odhan karnaa 78/100 ≈ π/4.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.4: Sidaa darteed π waa 3.12, tanina waa ka yar tahay 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.5: Haddii aan baraha ka dhigno 1000, natiijadu hubaal ayay ugu dhowaan doontaa 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 5aad wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qiyaasta 3.12 ee 100 bar sida haddii ay tahay qiimaha π, sadarka 6aad na wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in ku darista baro ay 'hubaal' ugu dhowaan doonto. Tijaabo kadis ah waxay bixisaa natiijo kala duwan xataa haddii aad isla hab ku sameyso mar kale, baro badan na kala firidhka wuxuu u janjeeraa inuu yaraado, laakiin dammaanad ma jirto in hal natiijo ay ka dhow tahay. Tallaabooyinka sadarrada 1 ilaa 4 (saami → π/4 → 4 jeer) waa la isticmaali karaa sida ay yihiin.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.prompt: Shan koox mid walba wuxuu dhigay 100 bar si isku mid ah wuxuuna tiriyey baraha kala-wareegga ku jira, wuxuuna helay 78, 81, 74, 80, iyo 77. Qiyaasaha 4×(tirada baraha)/100 waa 3.12, 3.24, 2.96, 3.20, 3.08, celcelisku na waa 3.12. Sidee u aragtaa hadalka 'tijaabadani waxay noo sheegaysaa π waa ka yar 3.14'?

y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.1: Farqigaas dhinac dhig farqiga u dhexeeya 3.14 iyo 3.12 oo isbarbar dhig.

y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.a: Tani ma kala saarto natiijo keliya oo si kadis ah u dhow iyo hab sax ah. Eeg sida qiimayaasha isla habka lagu celiyey ay u kala firidhsan yihiin.

y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.b: Qaadashada celcelis waxay yaraysaa kala firidhka, laakiin 500 bar weli kuma filna in lagu kala saaro farqiga 0.02 ee 3.12 iyo 3.14. Xisaabi intee le'eg ayaad celceliska aaminaysaa.
